H7E14: WITH p AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(pay_amount) AS amt FROM fact_order WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id), g AS (SELECT u.age_group, u.province, AVG(COALESCE(p.amt, 0)) AS a FROM dim_user u LEFT JOIN p ON p.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.age_group, u.province) SELECT age_group, province, ROUND(a, 2) FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY age_group ORDER BY a DESC) AS rk FROM g) t WHERE rk = 1
